grammar_focus: KS36+KS16 表示将来的几种方式(will/be going to、现在进行表已安排的将来 is arriving tomorrow、时间/条件状语从句用一般现在表将来 if it rains/the moment he arrives)(教材 L60 Key structures)主考;SD 名词作定语(village fair/Christmas card 代替 of 短语)+ 课文 the moment、intend to、rush towards(辅考)
scene: 在一个乡村集市上,我决定去拜访一位称作别林斯基夫人的算命人。我走进她的帐篷,她叫我坐下。我给了她一些钱后,她便查看着一个水晶球说道:“您的一个亲戚就要来看您了。她将于今天傍晚到达,并准备住上几天。您一走出这个帐篷,就会大吃一惊。一位您很熟悉的女人将向您冲来。她会对您说点什么,然后带您离开这个地方。就是这些。”我一走出帐篷,就把别林斯基夫人给我算卦的事忘得一干二净了,因为我的妻子正匆匆向我跑来。“你躲到哪儿去了?”她不耐烦地问,“再有不到一个小时你姐姐就要到这儿了,我们得去车站接她。现在就已经晚了。”当她走开时,我也跟着她出了集市。

grammar_card.title: 表示将来的几种方式
grammar_card.intro: KS36+KS16 表将来:①will/shall + 原形;②be going to + 原形(打算、迹象预测);③现在进行时表已安排好的将来(is arriving tomorrow);④在 if/when/as soon as/the moment/until/before/after 引导的时间、条件状语从句中,用一般现在时表将来(主句用 will)。

rows: I am going to travel by air.
If it rains, we shall stay home.
The moment he arrives, I'll call.

specialRules.rule: SD 名词作定语:常用名词直接修饰名词(复合名词)代替 of/介词短语:the fair in the village → the village fair;a card for Christmas → a Christmas card。
the moment 作连词='一…就…';intend to do=打算做;rush towards=向…冲去。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Does what Madam Bellinsky said come true?
options: It seems to — his wife (a woman he knows well) rushes towards him and leads him away

passage: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky. I went into her tent and she told me to sit down. After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball and said: 'A relation of yours is coming to see you. She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days. The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise. A woman you know well will rush towards you. She will speak to you and then she will lead you away from this place. That is all.' As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky because my wife hurried towards me. 'Where have you been hiding?' she asked impatiently. 'Your sister will be here in less than an hour and we must be at the station to meet her. We are late already.' As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.

stage5.stem: "A relation of yours ___ come to see you."(表将来'将要',助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 您的一个亲戚就要来看您了。

stage5.stem: "You ___ get a big surprise."(表将来'会',助动词)
"I ___ to travel by air."(表打算、计划做某事)
"Look at the clouds! It ___ to rain."(根据迹象预测'就要…了')
"She ___ this evening and intends to stay for a few days."(已安排好的将来,用现在进行时)
stage5.stem_cn: 她今晚到达,打算住几天。

stage5.stem: "He ___ at four o'clock."(已安排好的将来:四点来)
"She ___ in two days' time."(已安排好的将来:两天后离开)
"The moment you ___ this tent, you will get a big surprise."(时间状语从句里用一般现在时表将来)
stage5.stem_cn: 您一走出这帐篷,就会大吃一惊。

stage5.stem: "If it ___ tomorrow, we shall stay at home."(条件状语从句里用一般现在时表将来)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果明天下雨,我们就待在家里。

stage5.stem: "I shall let you know the moment he ___."(时间状语从句里用一般现在时表将来)
"As soon as the rain ___, we shall go out."(时间状语从句里用一般现在时表将来)
"I'll give him the message when he ___."(时间状语从句里用一般现在时表将来)
stage5.stem_cn: 他回来时我就把口信给他。

stage5.stem: "We went to the fair in the village. = We went to the ___."(用名词直接修饰,'乡村的集市'紧凑说法)
"He told us a story about ghosts. = He told us a ___."(用名词直接修饰,'关于鬼的故事'紧凑说法)
stage5.stem_cn: 他给我们讲了个鬼故事。

stage5.stem: "She gave me a present for my birthday. = a ___."(用名词直接修饰,'生日的礼物'紧凑说法)
stage5.stem_cn: 她送了我一件生日礼物。

stage5.stem: "He sent me a card for Christmas. = a ___."(用名词直接修饰,'圣诞的贺卡'紧凑说法)
"She will be arriving this evening and ___ to stay for a few days."(打算、意图做某事)
stage5.stem_cn: 她今晚到达,打算住几天。

stage5.stem: "A woman will rush ___ you and speak to you."(朝某人'冲过来'的方向介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 一个女人会向您冲来跟您说话。
